title: Value FULCRA: Mapping Large Language Models to the Multidimensional Spectrum of Basic Human Values
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, FULCRA, measures LLM outputs against Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values, which includes the specific value item 'Be holding religious faith (being devout and committed to one's religion)' as part of the 'Tradition' dimension. The paper also mentions related work, Touch23-ValueEval, that covers 'religious text'.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to the 'religious faith' value. The analysis is aggregated at the level of the ten primary basic values (one of which is 'tradition', which includes religious faith), without a specific breakdown for religion.
